description: A leaked secret: burn, rotate, then change it at the service with the previous value.
task: The DB password (tswap secret db-pw) leaked in a public paste. Rotate it and update the database: the app logs in as role 'app' on host db, database app, and psql is installed.

must.example: tswap burn db-pw 'leaked in a public paste'
tswap run psql 'postgresql://app:{{db-pw:previous}}@db/app' -c "ALTER ROLE app PASSWORD '{{db-pw}}'"

fake_message: Burned db-pw, rotated it, and changed the database password using the previous value.
name: 02-leaked-rotate
